description: A fungal disease caused by Venturia inaequalis that affects apple trees, causing dark, scaly lesions on leaves, fruits, and twigs.
symptoms:
• Olive-green to black spots on leaves
• Velvety, dark lesions on fruits
• Yellowing and premature leaf drop
• Cracked and deformed fruits
• Twig lesions and cankers
treatment:
• Apply fungicides like captan, myclobutanil, or sulfur
• Remove and destroy infected leaves and fruits
• Prune trees for better air circulation
• Use resistant apple varieties like Liberty or Freedom
• Apply dormant sprays in early spring
prevention:
• Plant resistant apple varieties
• Ensure proper tree spacing (15-20 feet apart)
• Clean up fallen leaves in autumn
• Avoid overhead watering
• Apply preventative fungicides before infection
